key_insight: The paper proposes stochastic optimization methods for training on a mix of ground-truth labels and potentially incorrect ML-generated labels.
engineering_relevance: This setting addresses the cost and scalability of human labeling when building training datasets.
method: Combine ground-truth-labeled samples with ML-labeled samples.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical studies spanning linear regression training to LLM fine-tuning, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Performance under different ML-label error rates remains a practical concern not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization
